grammarFocus: 让步与对比；关系从句；举例表达的多种形式。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. title: The Attention Study: A Museum Visit
instructions: 这是一份为B2–C1成人学习者设计的英语听力与语法练习，主题为旅游与文化讨论。请先听/读对话，再完成10道听力题（含单选、填空、判断正误/未提及）。然后学习语法讲解并完成8道语法题。所有题目答案均来自原文，请勿凭常识作答。本材料为模拟教学材料，非官方雅思试题。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, everyone. Thanks for coming to the museum today. I'm Mia, the study coordinator. This is a short study about how visitors allocate attention. Before we start, can I ask you a few questions?

Ben: Sure. I'm Ben. I usually spend a lot of time reading the labels, but my friend Leo just walks quickly and looks at the big paintings.

Mia: That's interesting. So, Ben, you focus on details, while Leo prefers a fast overview. Leo, is that right?

Leo: Yes, mostly. Although I sometimes stop for a sculpture, I don't read much. I take a photo and move on.

Mia: OK. Now, please wear this small eye-tracking glasses. They record where you look. The glasses are light, but they may feel strange at first.

Ben: Do they hurt? 

Mia: No, they don't. They just sit on your head. Please don't touch them during the visit.

Leo: How long is the visit?

Mia: About forty minutes. You can walk anywhere, but please stay in the main galleries. The special exhibition is closed today.

Ben: What are we looking for?

Mia: We want to know which parts of a painting people look at first. Some people look at faces, and others look at colors or shapes. There is no right answer.

Leo: So, we just look naturally?

Mia: Exactly. After the visit, I'll ask you to draw a quick map of one painting from memory. That will show what you noticed.

Ben: I'm not good at drawing.

Mia: Don't worry. It's not a test of art. It's just a memory task. Oh, and one more thing: please don't discuss the paintings with each other during the visit. You can talk afterwards.

Leo: Can we use our phones?

Mia: You can take photos, but please don't use social media inside the galleries. The light from screens can affect the eye-tracking data.

Ben: Got it. So, we look, we don't talk, and we don't post.

Mia: That's right. Any other questions? No? Great. Let's begin. Remember, the study is about attention, not about knowledge. Just be yourselves.

grammar.title: 让步与对比；关系从句；举例表达的多种形式
grammar.explanation: 本课重点：1) 让步与对比：用 although, while, but 等连接，表示“虽然/而”。例如：Although I sometimes stop for a sculpture, I don't read much. 2) 关系从句：用 who, which, that 等引导，修饰名词。例如：The painting which we saw yesterday was very famous. 3) 举例表达：用 such as, like 等。例如：Many fruits, such as apples and bananas, are good for you. 注意：新学形式为“关系从句中的 which 指代事物”，复习形式为“although 引导的让步状语从句”。
grammar.example: Although I sometimes stop for a sculpture, I don't read much.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ it was raining, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: 句子表示让步“虽然下雨，我们还是去散步了”，用 Although。Because 表原因，So 表结果。
questions.evidence: Although I sometimes stop for a sculpture, I don't read much.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She likes tea, ______ her brother prefers coffee.
questions.explanation: 这里对比两个人的喜好，用 while 表示“而”。because 表原因，so 表结果。
questions.evidence: So, Ben, you focus on details, while Leo prefers a fast overview.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The painting ______ we saw yesterday was very famous.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 painting（物），关系代词用 which。who 用于人，where 用于地点。
questions.evidence: We want to know which parts of a painting people look at first.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The man ______ is talking to Mia is my uncle.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 man（人），关系代词用 who。which 用于物，whose 表所属。
questions.evidence: This is a short study about how visitors allocate attention.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct phrase: Many fruits, ______ apples and bananas, are good for you.
questions.explanation: such as 用于列举同类事物，后接名词。for example 通常后接句子，that is 用于解释或换句话说。此处最合适是 such as。
questions.evidence: Some people look at faces, and others look at colors or shapes.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I don't read much, ______ I sometimes stop for a sculpture.
questions.explanation: 句子表示让步“虽然我有时会为雕塑停下来，但我不怎么读”，用 although。
questions.evidence: Although I sometimes stop for a sculpture, I don't read much.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct relative pronoun: This is the museum ______ we visited last year.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 museum（物），关系代词用 which 作 visited 的宾语。who 用于人，whose 表所属。
questions.evidence: You can walk anywhere, but please stay in the main galleries.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct phrase: Some people look at faces, and ______ look at colors or shapes.
questions.explanation: 这里表示“另一些人”，用 others。other 后需接名词，the other 指两者中的另一个。
questions.evidence: Some people look at faces, and others look at colors or shapes.

transfer.writing: Write a short paragraph (about 120 words) about a visit to a museum or gallery. Describe what you noticed first and why. Use at least one concessive clause (although/while) and one relative clause (which/who).
